name: Lost Deal Analysis Opportunity
query:
SELECT 
    o.name AS "Opportunity ID:Link/Opportunity:150",
    o.customer_name AS "Customer:Data:200",
    o.sales_stage AS "Sales Stage:Data:150",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lr.lost_reason SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Lost Reasons:Data:200",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.competitor SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Competitors:Data:200",
    o.order_lost_reason AS "Order Lost Reason:Data:200",
    o.transaction_date AS "Opportunity Date:Date:120",
    o.status AS "Status:Data:100"
FROM 
    `tabOpportunity` o
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabOpportunity Lost Reason Detail` lr ON lr.parent = o.name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabCompetitor Detail` c ON c.parent = o.name
WHERE 
    o.status = "Lost"
GROUP BY 
    o.name
ORDER BY 
    o.transaction_date DESC;
